seo.title: Pricing
seo.description: Transform & Heal: Embrace your journey through holistic mental health therapy.

pricingPolicy.text5: Slots can be booked via the booking link and then subsequently the payment can be made following booking the slot

refundPolicy.text2: Cancelations can be rescheduled or refunded
refundPolicy.text3: Cancelations before 24 hours of the scheduled appointment time will be refunded with 2% deduction of processing fee within 7 working days
refundPolicy.text7: Cancelations within 24 hours of the scheduled appointment time will not be refunded
refundPolicy.text8: No show on the scheduled appointment time slot will not be refunded
